environment: Disposable local WordPress Playground, SQLite; not production Divi

checks.name: Installation preserves current presentation until enabled
Anonymous preview parameter does not enable the layout
Authenticated admin preview renders new layout with noindex and no-cache
Published native posts render without duplication across featured and grid
Native pagination, category and full-text search work without JavaScript
Article content, unique table-of-contents IDs and one H1
Password, private and draft content stay protected; REST/feed and pages keep WP routing
Existing content remains unchanged; importer creates only two drafts and is idempotent
Importer rejects unprivileged execution and forged admin POST
Core SEO fallback has a single canonical, description and Article graph
Campaign parameters do not pollute canonical or Open Graph URL
Repeated cover is removed or retained once with its authored caption
Publishing another native post updates listing and search immediately
